name: Pronghorn (high desert juniper woodland, Bend)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2), made from the silvies palette and checked against the OSIP 2024 photo of the course (2026-10-31: fairways #5f8857 median, greens #6f8f60, bunkers #cbc19a, ponds #172646, native ground #998c71). Pronghorn, Bend OR, about 3,200 ft up on the east side of the Cascades: irrigated fairways, greens and a mown band of rough a clear green against the desert; the native ground of the rough (bunchgrass, sage and bitterbrush on pumice soil) a grey-tan, greyer and paler than Silvies' gold (F0-F2, inside config fescue_areas); off the course (L0-L2) the same desert a shade darker and more olive, so out of bounds reads apart from the rough; pale buff sand; deep navy ponds; grey basalt and stucco. Trees: western juniper in two growth forms, sage and bitterbrush as the theme's bush (assets-src/trees_pronghorn.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
